entities.name: Tanglewoods
entities.description: A small yet deadly forest of man-eating vines and carnivorous plants during the Dark Age of Terisiare.

entities.name: Sardian Mountains
entities.description: Mountains in whose crook the Tanglewoods nestled.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: A school of mages within sight of the Tanglewoods.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Pointed out the lands around the Conclave to Jodah.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Was shown the lands around the Conclave by Mairsil.

entities.name: Scarwoods
entities.description: A much larger forest compared to the Tanglewoods.

entities.name: Savaen Expanses
entities.description: A much larger forest compared to the Tanglewoods.
